details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:262-272 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The root hook does not distinguish stderr redirection from a numeric push refspec, so `git push origin 2>/dev/null` can check the current branch instead of branch `2`.
  WHY: A merged PR on branch `2` can go undetected; both reviewers rate this BLOCKER.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:430-478, 1315-1330 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The root hook does not resolve or request confirmation for unresolved push destinations or sources, and retains the old confirmation message.
  WHY: A push such as `git push origin "$TARGET"` can silently check only the current branch rather than the actual destination.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:496-498 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: An unresolved push destination falls back to checking the current branch without setting the bulk confirmation flag.
  WHY: A merged PR on the actual destination branch can go undetected.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1372-1376 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The confirmation message does not explain that the push source could not be resolved.
  WHY: The operator cannot make an informed decision about the unresolved push refspec.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:1000 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The byte-identical parity test fails because the root and template hooks differ.
  WHY: The template contains redirect and unresolved-destination handling absent from the root hook.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1316-1327 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: No test exercises the success path that replaces the target tip with the resolved source SHA.
  WHY: A regression in the SHA rewrite would go undetected; both reviewers describe this as a test-coverage gap, not a runtime failure.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:940
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: No test verifies that a resolvable source refspec resolves to the expected commit SHA and passes ancestry checks without requesting confirmation.
  WHY: Existing cases exercise the unresolved failure path, leaving the success path without regression coverage.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  WHY: A merged PR on branch 2 can be allowed because the guard checks the current branch instead.

  PROBLEM: An unresolved push destination falls back to the current branch without setting the bulk confirmation flag.
  WHY: A merged PR on the actual destination branch would not be detected.

  PROBLEM: The confirmation message does not tell the operator that the push refspec could not be verified.
  WHY: The operator cannot make an informed decision about the unresolved source.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "The merged-PR guard distinguishes git push origin 2>/dev/null (stderr redirection, check the current branch) from git push origin 2 > /dev/null (push branch 2, redirect stdout). When a push refspec contains an unresolved destination or source (for example git push origin "$TARGET"), checking the current branch alone is not enough; the hook asks for confirmation." (from README.md lines 1051-1054)
  Expected change site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py _shell_segments_with_operators, _push_targets, _evaluate_bash
  Evidence of absence: The root hook at lines 262-272 has a plain shlex tokenizer with no redirect_target, previous_token_end, or fd-detection logic. _push_targets at lines 406-478 has no remote_provided flag, no HEAD resolution, and the unresolved-branch path at line 471-473 does not emit bulk="unresolved git push destination". _evaluate_bash at lines 1345-1349 uses the old message without the unresolved-source handler. The root hook has exactly zero of the ~150 lines of changes the PR diff attributes to it.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "The consumer merge guard template distinguishes a numeric file-descriptor prefix (2>/dev/null) from a separated or quoted numeric push refspec (2 > /dev/null), checking the branch actually pushed in either case. When a push refspec has an unresolved destination or source, the guard asks for confirmation rather than relying on the checked-out branch alone." (from changelog.d/6055-heal-evidence-bundle.md lines 19-21)
  Expected change site: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py _push_targets at line 496-498, _evaluate_bash at lines 1372-1376
  Evidence of absence: The template has redirect handling at lines 262-271 (using plain isdigit() without ASCII/position-tracking checks) and has remote_provided at line 428 and HEAD resolution at lines 489-492. But the unresolved-destination path at line 496-498 still uses the old _GuardTarget without bulk="unresolved git push destination". The confirmation message at line 1374 still reads "Bulk git push may write more branches than the current branch" without the unresolved-source append. Without the bulk flag in _push_targets and the ""unresolved git push source"" append in _evaluate_bash, unresolved push refspecs never trigger confirmation.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

  Evidence of absence: None of these test functions exist on disk: test_unresolved_push_destination_requests_confirmation, test_unresolved_push_source_requests_confirmation, test_numeric_push_refspec_before_redirect_is_not_lost, test_fd_redirect_checks_current_push_branch (the parameterized version), test_quoted_numeric_refspec_before_redirect_is_preserved, test_non_ascii_digit_is_not_a_file_descriptor. The test file has 1418 lines ending with test_history_verdict_is_unavailable_without_a_default_branch and contains none of the unresolved-refspec or numeric-fd test functions the PR diff and last run diff add.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
